lead_headline: Denver Café & Kava opens Park Hill kava bar as Mukja Cafe launches first brick-and-mortar in RiNo — 8 new leads today

restaurant.blurb: 8 new leads today: Denver Café & Kava (Park Hill kava bar), Mukja Cafe (first brick-and-mortar after 7 years as food truck, Assembly RiNo), Tacos el Comando closure in Aurora.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the sixth consecutive day — the post-flood drought hits nine total days since April 29-30's 2,144-renewal deluge. The 7-day window remains pinned at 0 versus last week's 2,386-application flood, marking a 100% collapse from the normal 20-30 weekly baseline. State licensing remains silent on the pause, which now extends through Saturday with no queue visibility. Either applications are held offline awaiting batch release, or backend cleanup from the flood continues — but the nine-day freeze with zero official comment grows increasingly conspicuous. May's pipeline status remains opaque as the silence deepens.

Week-over-week growth holds as editorial desks maintain normal cadence heading into the weekend.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −1 yesterday (0 new, 1 canceled) trims MTD to +16 (+2.0/day) but holds 90-day net at +135. The single cancellation breaks an eight-day zero-churn streak — the longest clean run since tracking began — and marks May's first subscription loss after 16 consecutive adds. This week still delivers +13 net (17 new, 4 canceled), outpacing last week's flat performance (+0: 20 new, 20 canceled) as acquisition holds while churn remains suppressed 80%. MTD's +2.0/day rate runs 43% ahead of YTD's +1.4/day baseline, absorbing yesterday's lone cancel without derailing May's momentum. The pattern shows retention mechanisms still engaged despite the streak break.
